design choices to defend: coordination leases stay on the sealed CapabilityAuthority; run-level records keyed by team_run_id; a dissent is resolved only by its author or the escalation target; one budget step per assign, commit, complete and handoff (charged to the recipient)

a tool receipt presented to record_tool_invocation is shape-checked and bound to the agent run of the commitment holder, and its taint is forced to TOOL_OUTPUT/UNTRUSTED; the receipt is not signed by the runtime, so its lease and decision identifiers are recorded as presented (no normative receipt signature)
the Governed Context digest of a recorded tool receipt is not compared with the recording call: the tool call and the recording call carry their own correlation identifiers
the HandoffEnvelope budget_remaining is the sender's headroom at the run level while the handoff step is charged to the recipient
